positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a new full-stack app on Google Search for business messaging
- Developed with Angular, TypeScript, and RxJS to build dynamic web applications
- Implemented features that improved core metrics such as CSAT, engagement, and user retention
- Reduced latency across RPC calls by improving caching and by fixing performance bugs
- Built E2E tests to validate browser compatibility and to automatically check for regressions
- Carried out performance audits to reduce initial load time and to improve build speed

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained a React/Redux real-time messaging application
- Improved caching across multiple services to reduce latency and server load
- Worked on localization to scale to over 40+ languages
- Built a CI/CD pipeline for automated building, testing, and deployment 
- Created a declarative framework using TypeScript for building UI components
- Profiling and performance tuning: browser compatibility, load speed, service latency

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a messaging platform serving 174 countries
- Designed and built an in-house A/B testing framework
- Utilized microservice backend architecture and gRPC to build scalable services
- Developed integrations with multiple IAP services
- Leveraged React Native to build native applications for both iOS and Android
